correctness.rationale: Conditional on movement count K_n=m, T_n is exactly m^(-1/2) times a fair-sign sum. The package gives an exponential tilt with rate I(y)=y²/2+y^4/12+O(y^6), tilted uniform Berry–Esseen with controlled lattice error, and relative normal-tail comparison showing r_m(x)->exp(-d^4/12) whenever x/m^(1/4)->d finite. A real Theorem 1 by Juškevičius–Šileikis supplies uniform absolute-martingale-to-Gaussian-tail factor 2e³/9; symmetry transfers this to one-sided tails, including small m. Combined with cited a.s. positive W_p movement clock convergence, bounded convergence proves the random mixture, sequential uniformity and both tails. Independent binomial evaluations at m=10^3,...,10^6 corroborate but do not prove the infinite limit.

originality.rationale: Fixed-sample sign-sum Cramér–Petrov quartic behavior and Gaussian martingale domination are known inputs, and the exact minimal-walk model was published immediately beforehand. The asserted novelty is the mixed, nonconcentrating Mittag–Leffler critical profile plus uniform polynomial-relative range for the symmetric positive two-point step law. Best-of-knowledge PASS is qualified by unavailable full text of the closely related minimal-walk paper and general random-index tail theorems.
